title: Ingress Anomaly Map
summary: An interactive map of every recorded Ingress anomaly outcome worldwide.
description: Browse the full history of Ingress anomaly sites on an interactive map, colour-coded by faction outcome and sized by recency, with multi-select series and country filters, optional auto pan-and-zoom to your selection, and per-site popups showing each event and score at that location. Backed by a curated, geocoded dataset covering every anomaly series.
